records.text: She was doing, and just showing you some of them, and then they got blocked for commenting in this way, telling her first and foremost, 'The timing of this is atrocious. On the anniversary of Charlie Kirk's death, you don't make a tribute to him, but you post about Candace (Candace Owens). Wow. Okay, forgiving Candace (Candace Owens) for doing what Charlie (Charlie Kirk) taught us all to do: ask questions, search for truth of what really happened to Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and why. I love your stuff, girl, but I feel like you really, really missed it with your weird allegiance to weird Turning Point USA.'
records.speaker: Candace Owens
